scripts.mobile:build:dev:ios: pnpm --filter @skill-spark/mobile exec eas build --profile development --platform ios
scripts.mobile:build:dev:android: pnpm --filter @skill-spark/mobile exec eas build --profile development --platform android
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @skill-spark/contracts build && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/api-client build && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/backend build && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/web build && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/mobile build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @skill-spark/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @skill-spark/mobile typecheck
scripts.db:types: pnpm exec supabase gen types --lang typescript --local > packages/contracts/src/database.types.ts
scripts.test:backend:local: pnpm exec supabase db reset && NODE_ENV=test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55422/postgres pnpm --filter @skill-spark/backend exec jest --watchman=false --runInBand
